sections.title: Previous Day Summary
sections.text: METIO BNA PDC 10 5/8" Y MOTOR DE FONDO HASTA 4800 M, TOMO PESOS DE SARTA C/S CIRCULACIÓN, CONTINUO BAJANDO BNA PDC Y MOTOR CON ROTACIÓN Y CIRCULACIÓN HASTA 5155 M, DONDE CHECO CIMA DE CTO CON 5 TON, REBAJO CTO CONSISTENTE DE 5155 A 5357 M, BOMBEO 8 M3 DE BACHE VISCOSO Y CIRCULA LIMPIANDO POZO. (Ran BNA PDC 10 5/8" and downhole motor to 4800 m, took string weights with/without circulation, continued running BNA PDC and motor with rotation and circulation to 5155 m, where checked cement top with 5 ton, drilled out hard cement from 5155 to 5357 m, pumped 8 m3 of viscous pill and circulated cleaning well)

sections.title: Lithology
sections.text: LITOLOGIA A 5,400 M: 80% MUDSTONE GRIS CLARO, CAFE CLARO Y BLANCO CREMA EN PARTES DOLOMITICO, LIGERAMENTE ARCILLOSO, ALGUNOS FRAGMENTOS PRESENTAN LINEAS MICROESTILILITICAS SELLADAS POR MATERIAL ARCILLO BITUMINOSO, ALGUNOS FRAGMENTOS PRESENTAN PARCHES DE ANHIDRITA, ALGUNOS FRAGMENTOS PRESENTAN MICROFRACTURAS SELLADAS POR CALCITA.20% ANHIDRITA BLANCA.ESPORADICO FRAGMENTOS DE PACKSTONE DE PELOIDE, OOIDES CAFE CLARO Y GRIS CLARO. SOLUBILIDAD GENERAL 40 % (LITHOLOGY AT 5,400 M: 80% MUDSTONE light gray, light brown and cream white, partly dolomitic, slightly clayey, some fragments present microstylolitic lines sealed by bituminous clay material, some fragments present anhydrite patches, some fragments present microfractures sealed by calcite. 20% WHITE ANHYDRITE. Sporadic fragments of peloid packstone, light brown and light gray ooids. General solubility 40%)
